title: Which companies allow AI in coding interviews
excerpt: Which companies let you use AI in their coding interviews, which ban it, and which built the interview around it. A public, editable index with sources.
content_html: AnthropicLive interviews are AI-free unless stated; some take-homes explicitly allow it.Live interviews are AI-free unless stated; some take-homes explicitly allow it.San
